/* ---- 2. one job per color: a workup meaning is a colored word in the accent; structure (arrows, labels, icons) is
        the accent; step captions are grey; step numbers are neutral raised discs, never dark filled ones ---- */
.w5a .w5m{color:var(--accent)}
.lcp .wr2 > .mask,.lcp .wr2 > span:not(.mask-toggle){color:var(--accent)}
body .axm-study .w5a .w5m .mask:not(.shown), body .w5a.axm-study .w5m .mask:not(.shown),
body .axm-study .lcp .wr2 > .mask:not(.shown), body .lcp.axm-study .wr2 > .mask:not(.shown){color:var(--ink-2)}
.lcp .pt:first-child .when{color:var(--muted)}
figure.lcp .step{background:var(--raised);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--ec),0 0 0 1px rgba(24,28,30,.12)}

/* ---- 3. wide tables: an alternating faint recessed band with rounded ends replaces the row rules ---- */
@media (min-width:641px){
  .tw table:not(.script){border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0}
  .tw table:not(.script) > tbody:not(.grp):not(.first) > tr > td{border-top-color:transparent}
  .tw table:not(.script) > tbody:not(.grp):not(.first) > tr:nth-child(even){background:none}
  .tw table:not(.script) > tbody:not(.grp):not(.first) > tr:not(.em):nth-child(odd) > td{background:var(--row-tint)}
  .tw table:not(.script) > tbody > tr > td:first-child{border-radius:12px 0 0 12px}
  .tw table:not(.script) > tbody > tr > td:last-child{border-radius:0 12px 12px 0}
  .tw table:not(.script) > tbody > tr > td:only-child{border-radius:12px}
}
/* the systems panel: rows on the same band instead of separate recessed tiles */
.brief.sp .sp-sysr{gap:0}
.brief.sp .sp-sysr > div{background:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:12px}
.brief.sp .sp-sysr > div:nth-child(odd){background:var(--row-tint)}
/* the 5a workup: tinted by test group; the clue band keeps its own darker tint */
.w5a .w5t,.axm-flat .w5a .w5t{background:none;box-shadow:none}
.w5a .w5t:nth-of-type(odd){background:var(--row-tint)}
.w5a .w5t.first,.axm-flat .w5a .w5t.first{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--axh-F2F1FA) 0%,var(--axh-EDECF7) 60%,var(--axh-E9E8F4) 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(var(--acc-rgb),.32)}

/* ---- section glows: a faint wash behind each step heading (the workup's in the accent) ---- */
.brief.sp{isolation:isolate}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h{position:relative}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;left:-20px;top:50%;width:520px;height:200px;margin-top:-100px;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 240px 70px at 20px 50%,var(--glow,transparent),rgba(239,240,240,0) 100%)}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s1"],.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s7"]{--glow:rgba(42,98,87,.12)}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s2"]{--glow:rgba(142,90,22,.11)}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s3"],.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s5"]{--glow:rgba(10,84,97,.10)}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s4"]{--glow:rgba(var(--acc-rgb),.14)}
.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s6"],.brief.sp h5.sp-h[id$="-s8"]{--glow:rgba(58,62,112,.10)}
.axm-flat .brief.sp h5.sp-h::before,.brief.sp.axm-flat h5.sp-h::before{content:none}

/* ---- 5. glass: hover cards, drawers, the floating toolbar and the scroll-edge blur ---- */
.sp-card{background:var(--glass-2);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(40px) saturate(190%);backdrop-filter:blur(40px) saturate(190%);box-shadow:var(--glass-edge-2);border-radius:20px;
  transform-origin:16px 0;animation:axpop .5s var(--bnc,ease-out)}
@keyframes axpop{from{transform:scale(.6,.4);opacity:0;filter:blur(6px)}to{transform:none;opacity:1;filter:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sp-card{animation:none}}
.sp-drawer{background:var(--glass-2);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(40px) saturate(190%);backdrop-filter:blur(40px) saturate(190%);box-shadow:var(--glass-edge-2);border-radius:28px}
.sp-drawer .sp-dbar{background:rgba(250,250,252,.82);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);backdrop-filter:blur(20px)}
.sp-scrim{background:rgba(10,10,14,.22);opacity:1}
#axbar,#axedge{display:none}
@media (min-width:1101px){
  #axedge{display:block;position:fixed;top:0;left:var(--sidebar);right:0;height:84px;z-index:55;pointer-events:none;
    background:linear-gradient(rgba(239,240,240,.9),rgba(239,240,240,0));-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 45%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 45%,transparent)}

    background:var(--glass);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(180%);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(180%);box-shadow:var(--glass-edge);font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--ink)}
  #axbar .axcur{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:150px;max-width:260px;padding:0 12px 0 4px}
